description: Free-parameter void family fits in native mu-space with full 1701x1701 STAT+SYS covariance and marginalized zero-point. Tests whether the void family degenerates to flat when amplitude and scale are free parameters.
methodology: All models are evaluated as relative modulus shapes s(z) = 5*log10(H_ref/H(z)) against the Pantheon+ distance-modulus residual d = mu - mu_ref, with the full STAT+SYS covariance and analytically marginalized zero-point. AIC penalizes 2k per model (k=1 for flat, k=3 for void/TEP with 2 free shape params + zero-point).
